reason: It asserted that a graph neighbour sharing no word with the query is dropped from an ordinary search. Since every unnamed search runs the graph leg (docs/research/2026-11-17-every-search-runs-every-leg.md), that gate dropped the neighbours a relation question asks for, which the review of commit b98f68a7 found to be a regression. Text overlap now orders graph rows instead of admitting them, so the test asserts the exact order: the weak text hit first and the neighbour after it. The neighbour still cannot beat the text hit, which is what the test name claims; the direct graph query keeps its assertion unchanged.
